paper.title_en: Characterization of an Optical Time Projection Chamber prototype with Ar:CF$_4$ at atmospheric pressure
paper.abstract_en: We report on the characterization of an Optical Time Projection Chamber (OTPC) developed as a prototype for neutron-induced reaction studies at Soreq Applied Research Accelerator Facility (SARAF). The prototype was operated with Ar:CF$_4$ (95:5) at 1 bar, using parallel mesh electrodes for charge multiplication and electroluminescence, and alpha particles from a $^{241}$Am source. Both induced charge and light signals were recorded. A systematic characterization was carried out to study charge multiplication and scintillation yield. We present the results of these measurements in single-gap amplification configurations, along with two-gap operation and a demonstration of synchronized optical readout.
